video.title: Genesis 4 - The Brother's Blood
video.notes: Genesis 4 revision: vengeance, mercy and lineage. Keeps the 312-second source song, all 498 literal lyric words, and accepted story photographs. Applies two paired-local-alignment cue corrections near 2:29 and removes the avoidable 110ms lyric fade delay. Replaces ten repeated linear treatments with filled circular masses, broad crescents, monoliths, seals and typographic silhouettes. The pivotal 7-to-77 sequence becomes one continuous 13-second escalation, followed by an explicitly labeled Matthew 18:22 forgiveness inversion with a unique photoreal Christ composition. Sung wording remains 'seventy times seven'; 77 is an interpretive visual. Genealogy scenes show correct Cain and Seth/Enos relationships with luminous name transitions. Orthodox direction and readings are archived with the project. Pending Shane's review; prior candidates retained. Strict machine sung-word certification is reported separately from visual judgment. Film SHA256 6f1d33843be71917ff109d834d536452fa6e8bba9d7b195c156cc7ea235097ca.
